boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Princeton University
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food and convenience stops with directly documented evening or overnight availability near campus.

cards.title: Frist Food Gallery Late Dinner
cards.subtitle: Frist Campus Center · Monday–Thursday to 10 p.m.
cards.notes: Use a meal-plan late dinner when regular dining hours have ended; confirm break-period availability before heading to Frist.
cards.short_summary: Campus late-meal service at the Frist Campus Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Princeton Campus Dining lists Late Dinner at Frist Gallery Monday through Thursday from 8:30 to 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Late Dinner is listed Monday–Thursday, 8:30–10 p.m.; it is for students with a purchased meal plan and is inactive during break periods.

cards.title: Wawa on Alexander Street
cards.subtitle: 152 Alexander St · Open 24 hours
cards.notes: For a food, drink, or convenience-item stop at any hour, use the store by the Dinky station and Forbes College.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock convenience stop beside campus transit.
cards.evidence_claim: Princeton Admission identifies the Wawa between the Dinky station and Forbes College as open 24/7.
cards.source_title: My Go-to Spots for Late Night Cravings | Princeton Admission
cards.access_notes: Princeton Admission states that this Wawa is open 24/7 and locates it between the Dinky station and Forbes College.

cards.title: Studio ’34
cards.subtitle: Butler College basement · Wednesday–Sunday, 9 p.m.–2 a.m.
cards.notes: Bring a Princeton ID for the Butler College basement convenience stop; it is a later option only on its listed nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Princeton Admission lists Studio ’34 in Butler College’s basement as operating Wednesday through Sunday from 9 p.m. to 2 a.m.
cards.source_title: My Go-to Spots for Late Night Cravings | Princeton Admission
cards.access_notes: The University source lists Wednesday–Sunday hours of 9 p.m.–2 a.m.; confirm access requirements and academic-calendar changes before visiting.

cards.title: Hoagie Haven
cards.subtitle: 242 Nassau St · Open late daily
cards.notes: Head west on Nassau Street for a made-to-order hoagie; the restaurant’s own mobile site lists weekday and weekend service as “Late.”
cards.short_summary: A Nassau Street sandwich counter with late service listed daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Hoagie Haven’s official mobile site lists Monday–Friday and Saturday–Sunday service as continuing “Late.”
cards.access_notes: Official site lists “M-F 8:30AM - Late” and “S-S 9:00AM - Late”; call ahead for a specific closing time.

cards.title: Tacoria on Nassau Street
cards.subtitle: 110 Nassau St · Friday–Saturday to 10 p.m.
cards.notes: Use the Nassau Street location for tacos, burritos, bowls, or vegan menu choices when its Friday or Saturday evening hours fit.
cards.short_summary: A quick-service Mexican restaurant with weekend 10 p.m. closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Tacoria lists its Princeton location open until 10 p.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours are 11:30 a.m.–10 p.m. Friday and Saturday; Sunday–Thursday close at 9 p.m.

cards.title: Princeton Pizza Star
cards.subtitle: 301 N Harrison St · Daily to 10 p.m.
cards.notes: Plan a pickup or meal at the North Harrison Street shop when you need a documented 10 p.m. closing option.
cards.short_summary: A pizza restaurant with daily evening hours to 10 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Princeton Pizza Star’s official site states that it is open daily from 10:30 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The official site lists daily hours of 10:30 a.m.–10 p.m.; verify holiday hours before departing.

cards.title: Alfonso’s Pizzeria & Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 1225 State Rd · Listed to 9:30 p.m.
cards.notes: Use this State Road pizzeria for a later dinner or pickup, checking the live hours panel on the restaurant’s official site first.
cards.short_summary: A State Road pizza stop with a listed 9:30 p.m. close.
cards.evidence_claim: Alfonso’s official website lists its hours as 10 a.m. to 9:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: The restaurant’s official site displays hours through 9:30 p.m.; confirm the day’s status before travel.

cards.title: Prince Tea House
cards.subtitle: 4437 Route 27 · Friday–Saturday to 10 p.m.
cards.notes: Choose the Route 27 location for tea, desserts, or food on Friday and Saturday evenings; it has different weekday hours.
cards.short_summary: A tea-house option with 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Prince Tea House lists its Princeton location open Friday and Saturday from 11 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Listed Princeton hours are Friday–Saturday 11 a.m.–10 p.m.; Sunday–Thursday close at 9 p.m., and Tuesday is closed.

cards.title: Mamoun’s Falafel
cards.subtitle: 20 Witherspoon St · Daily to 9 p.m.
cards.notes: For a straightforward evening meal on Witherspoon Street, order before the restaurant’s listed 9 p.m. daily close.
cards.short_summary: A daily evening falafel and Middle Eastern food option.
cards.evidence_claim: Mamoun’s official Princeton location page lists daily hours of 11 a.m. to 9 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official hours are 11 a.m.–9 p.m. every day; takeout runs from open until 30 minutes before closing.

cards.title: Pizza Den
cards.subtitle: 242½ Nassau St · Friday–Saturday to 9:30 p.m.
cards.notes: Use the storefront beside Hoagie Haven for pizza or sliders on Friday or Saturday, when its official hours extend to 9:30 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A Nassau Street pizza spot with later Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Den lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11 a.m. to 9:30 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official hours list Friday–Saturday 11 a.m.–9:30 p.m.; Monday–Thursday close at 9 p.m. and Sunday is closed.
